title: 密閉式堆肥反應器~In-vessel composting reactors
focus: 密閉堆肥的混料、供氧、散熱與成熟度證據~Blend, oxygenate, cool and verify maturation in enclosed composting
summary: 本課以「密閉堆肥的混料、供氧、散熱與成熟度證據」為主軸，依序處理可堆肥物與雜質驗收、含水率混合設計、需氧與送風分配、蒸發損失與補水、熟化速率與穩定度。十個單元各包含機制、算例、量測驗證及失效診斷；數值均為明示的原創教學假設，不能直接用作工程設計、排放限值或設備設定。~This course focuses on Blend, oxygenate, cool and verify maturation in enclosed composting, progressing through Compostable feed and contamination, Moisture blending, Oxygen demand and air distribution, Evaporation and water replacement, Curing rate and stability. Ten units each address mechanism, worked calculation, measurement verification and failure diagnosis. Numbers are explicit original teaching assumptions, not design values, emission limits or equipment settings.
history: 這項技術的學習脈絡由單一設備處理，逐步擴展至物質與能量收支、監測品質和生命週期比較。本課將官方方法文件作為查核入口，並以獨立編寫的假想數據練習；參考文件的年代與地區不代表其規範在所有場址適用。~The learning progression expands from individual treatment equipment to mass and energy balances, monitoring quality and lifecycle comparison. Official method documents provide verification starting points while independently authored hypothetical data support practice; a document date or jurisdiction does not establish applicability to every site.

units.title: 可堆肥物與雜質驗收~Compostable feed and contamination
units.mechanism: 進料分選須辨認可分解有機物與不屬於堆肥產品的雜質，粉碎不等於去除污染。 分率必須以同一濕基或乾基定義；總質量乘分率才是該成分的質量。~Receiving inspection separates compostable organics from product contaminants; shredding does not remove contamination. Fractions require a consistent wet or dry basis; multiplying total mass by its fraction gives component mass.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：總進料 m=1000 kg；目標成分質量分率 f=0.18。公式 m_target=m*f，計算得 180 kg。適用邊界：批次均勻且分樣具代表性；不把質量分率當體積分率。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Total feed m=1000 kg; target-component mass fraction f=0.18. Formula m_target=m*f gives 180 kg. Applicability: A homogeneous batch and representative sampling; mass fraction is not volume fraction.
units.verify: 針對「可堆肥物與雜質驗收」，秤總樣與分離後成分，保存含水率與分樣方式，檢查回收率。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Compostable feed and contamination, Weigh the bulk sample and separated fraction; retain moisture basis and sampling procedure and check recovery. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 濕基與乾基混用會令回收物或負荷被高估。 在「可堆肥物與雜質驗收」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~Mixing wet and dry bases overstates recovered material or loading. Mark where this error can enter the Compostable feed and contamination flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 相同百分比不論濕基或乾基都代表相同質量。~The same percentage gives the same mass on wet and dry bases.
units.practice: 只將 f 改成 0.22，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 180 變成 220 kg。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only f to 0.22, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 180 to 220 kg. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

units.title: 碳氮總量配料~Carbon-nitrogen blend accounting
units.mechanism: 將木質調理料與含氮廚餘逐批分析；總碳氮比需與實際可利用碳一起解讀。 混合碳氮比由碳總質量除以氮總質量；各原料碳氮比的算術平均一般不成立。~Analyze woody bulking material and nitrogen-rich food waste by batch; interpret total C:N alongside available carbon. A blend C:N ratio is total carbon divided by total nitrogen; an arithmetic mean of feedstock ratios is generally invalid.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：原料 A：C=30 kg、N=2 kg；原料 B：C=50 kg、N=0.5 kg。公式 C_to_N=(CA+CB)/(NA+NB)，計算得 32 kg C/kg N。適用邊界：元素總量基準，未區分可生物利用性；數值不是配方建議。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Feed A: C=30 kg, N=2 kg; feed B: C=50 kg, N=0.5 kg. Formula C_to_N=(CA+CB)/(NA+NB) gives 32 kg C/kg N. Applicability: Total elemental basis, without bioavailability; the values are not a recipe recommendation.
units.verify: 針對「碳氮總量配料」，用原料乾質量與元素分析求 C、N 質量，再檢查混合樣。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Carbon-nitrogen blend accounting, Use dry feed mass and elemental analysis to calculate C and N masses, then check the blend. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 相同總 C:N 仍可能因木質素或抑制物而有不同分解速度。 在「碳氮總量配料」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~The same total C:N can yield different degradation rates because of lignin or inhibitors. Mark where this error can enter the Carbon-nitrogen blend accounting flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 兩種原料混合後的碳氮比永遠是兩個比值的平均。~A blend C:N ratio is always the average of the two feed ratios.
units.practice: 只將 B 的 N 改成 1 kg，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 32 變成 26.6667 kg C/kg N。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only B nitrogen to 1 kg, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 32 to 26.6667 kg C/kg N. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

units.title: 含水率混合設計~Moisture blending
units.mechanism: 濕料提供水分但可能壓縮通氣空間，調理料需求應由水收支與孔隙共同決定。 以水質量守恆求混料量；混合後總重量也改變，所以不能直接相減含水率。~Wet feed supplies moisture but may restrict aeration; select bulking demand from both water balance and porosity. Use water-mass conservation to size a blend; total mass also changes, so subtracting moisture percentages is insufficient.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：濕料 m=1000 kg；含水率 w=0.70；調理料含水率 wb=0.20；目標 wt=0.55。公式 m_b=m*(w-wt)/(wt-wb)，計算得 428.571 kg。適用邊界：無蒸發、無反應、濕基分率；兩種原料混合，不代表實際最佳堆肥含水率。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Wet feed m=1000 kg; moisture w=0.70; bulking-agent moisture wb=0.20; target wt=0.55. Formula m_b=m*(w-wt)/(wt-wb) gives 428.571 kg. Applicability: No evaporation or reaction, wet-basis fractions and two feedstocks; the target is not an operational compost optimum.
units.verify: 針對「含水率混合設計」，對原料與混合樣作同一乾燥法量測，核對預測值與不同位置樣本。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Moisture blending, Measure both feeds and blend by the same drying method; compare prediction with spatial subsamples. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 調理料本身很濕，卻仍用乾料假設計算，會低估需要量。 在「含水率混合設計」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~Treating a wet bulking agent as dry underestimates required addition. Mark where this error can enter the Moisture blending flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 加多少調理料只取決於原料的含水率差，不受調理料自身含水率影響。~Bulking demand depends only on the feed moisture gap, not on bulking-agent moisture.
units.practice: 只將調理料 wb 改成 0.30，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 428.571 變成 599 kg。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only bulking-agent wb to 0.30, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 428.571 to 599 kg. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

units.title: 填料孔隙與壓實~Bed porosity and compaction
units.mechanism: 在反應器剖面觀察壓實層；相同風量下，不同堆積狀態產生不同氧分布。 空氣孔隙是總體積扣除固體和水；總孔隙高不代表可供氣體通過的連通孔隙高。~Inspect compacted layers in a reactor section; equal air supply gives different oxygen distributions for different packing. Air-filled porosity is bulk volume less solids and water; high total porosity does not ensure connected gas pathways.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：堆體體積 V=10 m³；固體體積 Vs=3.0 m³；液體體積 Vw=2.5 m³。公式 air_fraction=(V-Vs-Vw)/V，計算得 0.45 m³ air/m³ bulk。適用邊界：體積可加的簡化；未計壓縮、粒徑分布與連通性。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Bulk volume V=10 m³; solid volume Vs=3.0 m³; water volume Vw=2.5 m³. Formula air_fraction=(V-Vs-Vw)/V gives 0.45 m³ air/m³ bulk. Applicability: Additive-volume approximation without compression, particle-size distribution or connectivity.
units.verify: 針對「填料孔隙與壓實」，測堆積密度、含水量和壓降，分辨孔隙不足與氣流短路。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Bed porosity and compaction, Measure bulk density, moisture and pressure drop to distinguish insufficient porosity from gas bypass. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 過度壓實或積水會關閉氣道，讓平均送風量失去代表性。 在「填料孔隙與壓實」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~Compaction or waterlogging closes gas paths, making mean airflow unrepresentative. Mark where this error can enter the Bed porosity and compaction flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 只要總孔隙率高，氣體一定能均勻流過每個位置。~High total porosity guarantees uniform airflow everywhere.
units.practice: 只將 Vw 改成 3.5 m³，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 0.45 變成 0.35 m³ air/m³ bulk。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only water volume Vw to 3.5 m³, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 0.45 to 0.35 m³ air/m³ bulk. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

units.title: 需氧與送風分配~Oxygen demand and air distribution
units.mechanism: 把微生物需氧量與送風網路連結，利用區域讀值尋找缺氧口袋。 所需空氣量受到氧含量和有效利用率限制；供氣量不是微生物實際吸收氧量。~Link microbial oxygen demand to the air network and use zone readings to locate oxygen-depleted pockets. Air demand depends on oxygen fraction and effective utilization; supplied air is not the oxygen actually consumed by microbes.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：氧需求 D=12 kg O₂/h；空氣氧質量分率 x=0.232；假設利用率 η=0.35。公式 m_air=D/(x*eta)，計算得 147.783 kg air/h。適用邊界：以氧質量收支近似，不是送風機操作設定；未計熱量與水分控制。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Oxygen demand D=12 kg O₂/h; oxygen mass fraction in air x=0.232; assumed utilization η=0.35. Formula m_air=D/(x*eta) gives 147.783 kg air/h. Applicability: An oxygen mass-balance approximation, not a blower setting; heat and moisture control are excluded.
units.verify: 針對「需氧與送風分配」，在進出口量氧濃度與流量，觀察不同位置氧剖面而非只讀總管。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Oxygen demand and air distribution, Measure inlet and outlet oxygen and flow; inspect spatial oxygen profiles rather than only the main header. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 旁通氣流增加時總送風上升，但反應區仍可能缺氧。 在「需氧與送風分配」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~Increasing bypass airflow can raise total supply while reactive zones remain oxygen-limited. Mark where this error can enter the Oxygen demand and air distribution flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 送入的每一公斤氧都必定被微生物消耗。~Every kilogram of supplied oxygen is necessarily consumed by microbes.
units.practice: 只將 η 改成 0.25，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 147.783 變成 206.897 kg air/h。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only η to 0.25, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 147.783 to 206.897 kg air/h. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

units.title: 生物熱與顯熱移除~Biological heat and sensible cooling
units.mechanism: 堆體自行產熱，出風帶走熱量；溫度控制需兼顧反應速率與過度冷卻。 顯熱依質量流率、比熱與溫差線性變動；相變潛熱必須另外計入。~The pile generates heat while exhaust removes it; temperature control balances reaction and excessive cooling. Sensible heat changes with mass flow, heat capacity and temperature difference; latent heat requires a separate term.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：質量流率 m=2 kg/s；比熱 cp=1.5 kJ/(kg·K)；溫差 ΔT=40 K。公式 P=m*cp*dT，計算得 120 kW。適用邊界：固定比熱、無相變、定常流；不可代替完整設備熱平衡。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Mass flow m=2 kg/s; heat capacity cp=1.5 kJ/(kg·K); temperature difference ΔT=40 K. Formula P=m*cp*dT gives 120 kW. Applicability: Constant heat capacity, no phase change and steady flow; not a complete equipment heat balance.
units.verify: 針對「生物熱與顯熱移除」，在同一時段讀取流量與上下游溫度，加入散熱項後檢查能量殘差。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Biological heat and sensible cooling, Record flow and upstream/downstream temperatures over one interval; include losses and check the energy residual. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 忽略水分蒸發會把熱量全部誤算為升溫。 在「生物熱與顯熱移除」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~Ignoring evaporation incorrectly assigns all heat to temperature rise. Mark where this error can enter the Biological heat and sensible cooling flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 水分蒸發的能量已完全包含在固定比熱乘溫差內。~Evaporation energy is fully included in constant heat capacity times temperature rise.
units.practice: 只將 ΔT 改成 50 K，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 120 變成 150 kW。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only ΔT to 50 K, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 120 to 150 kW. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

units.title: 蒸發損失與補水~Evaporation and water replacement
units.mechanism: 將濕度與質量減少對照，區分蒸發造成的乾燥和生物分解造成的有機物減少。 相變將熱轉為水蒸氣焓；潮濕材料處理中，蒸發可能比顯熱更耗能。~Compare humidity with weight loss to distinguish evaporation-driven drying from biological organic-matter loss. Phase change transfers heat into water-vapour enthalpy; evaporation can dominate sensible heating in wet-material processing.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：蒸發水量 m=100 kg/h；假設潛熱 hfg=2257 kJ/kg。公式 P=m*hfg/3600，計算得 62.6944 kW。適用邊界：潛熱值只代表近常壓沸點示例，不模擬其他溫壓下的完整乾燥。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Evaporated water m=100 kg/h; assumed latent heat hfg=2257 kJ/kg. Formula P=m*hfg/3600 gives 62.6944 kW. Applicability: The latent heat represents a near-atmospheric boiling example, not full drying at other conditions.
units.verify: 針對「蒸發損失與補水」，做乾物質與水分收支，核對排氣含濕量及冷凝水。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Evaporation and water replacement, Close dry-solids and water balances, checking exhaust humidity and condensate. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 把材料減重全當作有機物破壞，會混淆乾燥與反應。 在「蒸發損失與補水」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~Treating all weight loss as organic destruction confuses drying with reaction. Mark where this error can enter the Evaporation and water replacement flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 濕料減重表示同樣質量的有機物已被分解。~A wet-material mass decrease means the same mass of organics was degraded.
units.practice: 只將 m 改成 130 kg/h，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 62.6944 變成 81.5028 kW。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only m to 130 kg/h, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 62.6944 to 81.5028 kW. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

units.title: 批次停留與短流~Batch residence and short-circuiting
units.mechanism: 連續進料設備須追蹤物料停留分布；平均時間不能證明每份物料都經歷相同條件。 名目停留時間由有效體積除以通過流量；短流、死區及固液停留差異不在單一平均值內。~Continuous reactors need material residence distributions; a mean duration does not prove identical histories for every portion. Nominal residence time is effective volume divided by flow; short circuits, dead zones and separate solids retention are not represented by one mean.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：有效體積 V=600 m³；平均流量 Q=30 m³/d。公式 HRT=V/Q，計算得 20 d。適用邊界：穩態平均流量及單相有效體積近似，不預測停留時間分布。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Effective volume V=600 m³; mean flow Q=30 m³/d. Formula HRT=V/Q gives 20 d. Applicability: Steady mean flow and a single effective volume; no residence-time distribution is predicted.
units.verify: 針對「批次停留與短流」，先扣除無效空間，再用示蹤或批次記錄核對停留時間是否分散。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Batch residence and short-circuiting, Subtract inactive volume, then compare tracer or batch records to detect a broad residence-time distribution. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 把幾何容積當有效容積，會掩蓋短流與未處理區。 在「批次停留與短流」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~Using geometric volume as effective volume hides short-circuiting and untreated zones. Mark where this error can enter the Batch residence and short-circuiting flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 有相同平均停留時間的設備，其所有粒子停留時間都相同。~Equal mean residence times imply identical residence times for every particle.
units.practice: 只將 Q 改成 40 m³/d，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 20 變成 15 d。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only Q to 40 m³/d, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 20 to 15 d. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

units.title: 熟化速率與穩定度~Curing rate and stability
units.mechanism: 熟化曲線需配合呼吸活性與再升溫觀察；一次低溫讀值可能只是乾燥或缺氧。 一階模型讓轉換速率與當下濃度成正比，對數濃度對時間近直線。~Interpret curing curves with respiration and reheating observations; one low-temperature reading may reflect dryness or oxygen shortage. A first-order model makes conversion rate proportional to current concentration; log concentration is approximately linear in time.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：初始量 C0=100 mg/L；假設一階常數 k=0.10 d⁻¹；時間 t=10 d。公式 C=C0*exp(-k*t)，計算得 36.7879 mg/L。適用邊界：固定環境與可利用性、無新污染源；不能外推成真實完工日期。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Initial C0=100 mg/L; assumed first-order rate k=0.10 d⁻¹; time t=10 d. Formula C=C0*exp(-k*t) gives 36.7879 mg/L. Applicability: Constant environment and availability with no new source; this does not predict a real completion date.
units.verify: 針對「熟化速率與穩定度」，用多時點數據擬合並保留未參與擬合的點，檢查尾端是否偏離一階趨勢。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Curing rate and stability, Fit multiple time points, hold some out and inspect late-time deviations from first-order behaviour. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 吸附、傳質或持續源項可造成拖尾，不能只調 k 強行吻合。 在「熟化速率與穩定度」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~Sorption, mass transfer or ongoing sources can cause tailing; changing k alone may hide the mechanism. Mark where this error can enter the Curing rate and stability flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 前兩點符合一階衰減就保證所有後續時間也符合。~Agreement with two early points guarantees first-order decay at all later times.
units.practice: 只將 k 改成 0.07 d⁻¹，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 36.7879 變成 49.6585 mg/L。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only k to 0.07 d⁻¹, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 36.7879 to 49.6585 mg/L. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

units.title: 密閉系統與故障交接~Enclosure failure and handoff
units.mechanism: 重播風機停機與排氣處理失效，在教學儀表上記錄可用時間和產品批次隔離。 可用率描述指定期間能工作的時間比例，並不等於合格產出率。~Replay fan or exhaust-treatment failure and document availability and affected batch segregation in the teaching interface. Availability is the working-time fraction over a specified period, not the compliant-output fraction.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：總計畫時數 T=1000 h；停機 t=60 h。公式 availability=(T-t)/T*100，計算得 94 %。適用邊界：明確定義計畫時間與停機分類；未納入性能降額或品質不合格。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Scheduled time T=1000 h; downtime t=60 h. Formula availability=(T-t)/T*100 gives 94 %. Applicability: Defined scheduled time and downtime categories; derating and rejected output are excluded.
units.verify: 針對「密閉系統與故障交接」，對照事件紀錄、備援切換和品質資料，分開統計不可用及不合格時間。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Enclosure failure and handoff, Compare event logs, backup switching and quality data, separating unavailable and nonconforming periods. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 設備在線但數據失效或處理不合格時，不能當作完整有效服務。 在「密閉系統與故障交接」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~An online unit with invalid data or nonconforming treatment is not fully effective service. Mark where this error can enter the Enclosure failure and handoff flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 可用率 100% 就能保證所有產出或量測都合格。~One hundred percent availability guarantees all output and measurements conform.
units.practice: 只將 t 改成 90 h，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 94 變成 91 %。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only downtime to 90 h, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 94 to 91 %. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.
